data.name: Logix custom-chip licensing / supply to other manufacturers
data.scope: All custom chips except ROMs, especially FlexiBUS computer and device controllers, are available to other computer manufacturers under individually negotiated contracts.

second_source_program.rights: Independent manufacture and sale to competing OEMs; non-exclusive; ERA CPU excluded from this agreement.
second_source_program.transfer: SMC-compatible ready-to-use masks, revisions, process know-how, known-good reference chips, wafer-test structures, test programs and on-site engineering assistance.
second_source_program.release_policy: Initial qualified sales in October; individual part qualification and volume ramp separate. video RAM is the highest-risk gate.
second_source_program.economics: Transfer/NRE funded by AION/Logix; external-sales royalties and minimum orders negotiated, not priced facts.
